paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: The effect of context masking perturbations by tag. Error bars indicate the standard deviation.

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the effect of different models on various linguistic tags, categorized into case, gender, number, and tense. The horizontal axis represents the tag categories in a linear format, labeled "tag", and includes the categories: case, gender, number, and tense. The vertical axis is labeled "effect" and also follows a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 20, with tick labels marked at intervals of 5 units. Each tag category features grouped bars representing different models or conditions, with each bar distinguished by a specific color corresponding to the legend on the chart: light blue for mBERT-L₂, dark blue for XLM-L₂, light green for mBERT-R₂, dark green for XLM-R₂, pink for mBERT-B₂, and red for XLM-B₂. In the "case" category, bars range approximately from 3 to 12, with mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ having the tallest bars. In contrast, the "tense" category shows shorter bars, with values close to zero. The "gender" and "number" categories exhibit moderate bar lengths but all bars are in between 0 and 5. There is no specific sorting of the bars within each tag, and none of the bars are visually emphasized beyond their assigned colors. The error bars indicate variability within the model effects for each linguistic tag, with case having bigger error bars for all its bars. A legend is given top right.
